messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"verse":66,"chapter":16,"text":"What will you do? Or how will you hide your sins before God and his angels?"},{"verse":67,"chapter":16,"text":"Behold, God is the judge. Fear him! Stop sinning, and forget your iniquities, to never again commit them. So will God lead you out, and deliver you from all suffering."},{"verse":68,"chapter":16,"text":"For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they will take away some of you, and feed you with that which is sacrificed to idols."},{"verse":69,"chapter":16,"text":"Those who consent to them will be held in derision and in contempt, and be trodden under foot."},{"verse":70,"chapter":16,"text":"For there will be in various places, and in the next cities, a great insurrection against those who fear the Lord."}],"book_code":"2ES","chapter":16}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 66,67,68,69,70 in this chapter.
